site_name: East Wick Phase 2, Development Parcel 5.6, Planning Delivery Zone 5
description: Submission of details pursuant to condition 6c) (Wheelchair user dwellings marketing) attached to planning permission 20/00482/REM dated 17/05/2021. (This application proposes for the 10 market wheelchair units to be sold or let to non-wheelchair users.)
decision_conditions: <span id="docs-internal-guid-6d1f81b5-7fff-2da7-5913-2e70188281c8"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The submission does not demonstrate: any engagement with LB Hackney and LB Tower Hamlets Housing teams; and that adverts and editorials were secured in publications that cater to those with disabilities/wheelchair users and that other offline press marketing was undertaken for at least 12 months before the anticipated practical completion of buildings containing the 10 market wheelchair homes. Therefore, insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that marketing has been undertaken fully in line with the aims of the Marketing Plan approved under 22/00449/AOD. As such, condition 6 part c) attached to planning permission 20/00482/REM dated 20.10.2021 cannot be discharged. This is contrary to LLDC Local Plan (2020) policy H.1 which requires an appropriate mix of housing and accommodation types to meet identified requirements, and London Plan (2021) policy D7 which requires suitable housing and genuine choice for London’s diverse population, including disabled people.</span></p><div><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div></span>
